title: Fabric Apps backend with the Rayfin SDK (Preview)

content.text: Rayfin (Preview) is an open-source SDK and CLI that lets developers and coding agents define a complete application backend in code—data models, APIs, identity, access policies, and business logic—and deploy it to Microsoft Fabric, where the resulting apps run as first-class items with built-in governance and direct access to OneLake. For more information, see Fabric Apps.
